notes: Programme's own page is the Parcoursup fiche; the double-diploma (Licence Gestion + DU Collège du Management) is presented there. Tuition: the university page states EUR 2,902/year for extracommunautaires in Licence 1ère, 2ème et 3ème année; the Parcoursup fiche itself only shows the 178 €/year rate for non-extracommunautaires (plus 510 € for the DU). Application channel omitted per task instructions, through Etudes en France/Campus France for an applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat. Document list: no document list is stated for this programme on the supplied pages.
